task: R14-E v2 - Geocode attempt-tracking + retry window (seed re-run speed fix)
summary: seed_from_config() no longer re-geocodes every coordinate-less record on every re-run. A per-entity attempt marker in the store kv table plus a stored-coords check bound geocoding to a retry window, so a re-run adds zero document versions and finishes in ~1s instead of ~50min.
what_changed: vn_geo/business.py: seed_from_config() now opens one SearchStore for the whole run, snapshots stored entity_id->meta, and replaces the unconditional geocode branch with a 3-way decision: attempt / geocode_skipped_recent (fresh marker) / geocode_skipped_enriched (stored entity already has coords).

Attempt marker: kv key 'geocode_attempted:<entity_id>' -> ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, written after EVERY real attempt (success AND failure). Fresh = marker exists and age < retry_days; absent marker => attempt.
Enriched-skip carries the stored lat/lng/geocode_status/confidence onto the incoming entity so the re-upsert adds ZERO new document versions (those fields are in store ENTITY_DIFF_FIELDS).
Politeness: time.sleep(1.5) runs after REAL attempts only; the skip paths never sleep.
business_geocode_missing:false => no attempts and no markers (existing semantics preserved).
Seed summary: ADDED keys only - per-area and totals 'geocoded', 'geocode_skipped_recent', 'geocode_skipped_enriched'. Existing keys (ok, seeded, areas, fetched, skipped_sources) unchanged.
tests/test_business_geocode_policy.py: new hermetic test file (7 tests, no network).

tests/test_business_seed.py: ONE assertion updated (test_seed_inserts_and_is_idempotent line ~92) - it did an exact-equality check on the per-area summary dict, which now carries the three new keys (geocoded=1). This is the only way to keep the suite green while adding the spec-mandated per-area keys; no other test file touched.

config_keys.business_geocode_retry_days: NEW, optional number, default 7. Read from the area config next to business_geocode_missing. Window (in days) during which a previously attempted entity is not re-geocoded. Non-numeric falls back to 7.
config_keys.business_geocode_missing: existing, default true. false => no geocode attempts, no markers.

counters.geocoded: attempts made this run (success or failure)
counters.geocode_skipped_recent: coordinate-less records skipped because a fresh attempt marker exists
counters.geocode_skipped_enriched: coordinate-less records skipped because the stored entity already has coords

new_tests: test_failed_attempts_mark_then_skip_on_rerun - run1: N failures -> markers written, geocoded=N; run2: geocoded=0, skipped_recent=N, ZERO new document versions, no extra sleeps
test_successful_attempt_is_enriched_skipped_on_rerun - run1 success -> run2 geocoded=0, skipped_enriched=1, zero new versions (stored coords carried)
test_stale_marker_retries_within_default_window - backdated markers (2020) with default 7d window -> run2 attempts again
test_geocode_missing_false_makes_no_attempts_or_markers - 0 geocoder calls, no markers, no sleeps
plus shared hermetic fixtures: monkeypatched _goong_geocode/_nominatim_geocode with call counters + monkeypatched time.sleep
